d:
Some melodies bring back the romance and emotions of the unforgettable 90s! Enjoy “Hasraten Hai Bahut Magar” from the Hindi film Aatish (1994), featuring Karisma Kapoor and Atul Agnihotri. With the soulful voices of Kumar Sanu and Sadhana Sargam, this memorable melody is a treat for fans of classic 90s Bollywood music and evergreen Hindi romantic songs.
